frase_gancho.texto: An elite neighborhood to the south, visited only with a guide.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Old Chichén is the Initial Series Group, a residential and ceremonial complex southwest of the center, with about twenty-five structures. It can only be visited on Fridays and Saturdays, in two shifts, with a reservation at the ticket office of the zone and an INAH guide. There are four stops. First, the Temple of the Initial Series, with a lintel bearing a date from the year eight hundred seventy-eight, probably moved from its original location. Then the Palace of the Phalli, the House of the Snails with the Turtle Platform, and the Gallery of the Monkeys, with reliefs of more than sixty monkeys and scenes of birds attacking dancing monkeys.
